identity-service.Name: Identity Service
identity-service.Description: M2M client for IdentityService to call OTPService

invoice-service.Name: Invoice Service
invoice-service.Description: M2M client for invoice integration events, service reads, and POS payment initiation.

pos-service.Name: POS Service
pos-service.Description: M2M client restricted to confirming completed POS payments to InvoiceService.

order-service.Name: Order Service
order-service.Description: M2M client for OrderService to read/write Quotations via SepidarGateway

catalog-service.Name: Catalog Service
catalog-service.Description: M2M client for CatalogService to read Items/Units/Currencies/Stocks via SepidarGateway

woosync-service.Name: WooSync Service
woosync-service.Description: M2M client for the Corevia Sync WooCommerce provider to create orders in OrderService and consume catalog events.

didarsync-service.Name: DidarSync Service
didarsync-service.Description: M2M client for DidarSyncService operational API and CatalogService-backed synchronization access.

customer-service.Name: Customer Service
customer-service.Description: M2M client for CustomerService to read/write Customers via SepidarGateway
